steps.action: Attach the Global Field and mark it Required
steps.actual: Attachment of "Ind coverage region IND81T2F" on "Ind supplier assessment IND81T2F revised" (already attached by the interrupted first attempt; the required box is set here); its Required box stayed checked after a reload.

steps.action: Creating without the required answer is refused by name
steps.actual: Creation refused while the required Field was empty, naming it: "Fill Ind coverage region IND81T2F.". The dialog stayed open and no Matter was created.

steps.action: Supplying a valid answer creates the Matter
steps.actual: Matter 24 was created once "Nordics" was supplied. Its Overview renders the Field as "Ind coverage region IND81T2F*" (the asterisk is the required marker) holding "Nordics".

steps.action: Detaching keeps the definition and the stored value
steps.actual: Detached the attachment. Matter 24 still holds "Nordics" and the catalog still lists the Field (archivedAt=null).

steps.action: Archive and restore the Field from the catalog
steps.actual: Archive dialog read "Archive Ind coverage region IND81T2F Ind coverage region IND81T2F is attached to 3 types — the attachments are kept, hidden until the field is restored. The change applies immediately and is recorded in the audit log. Cancel Archive field". Archiving hid the row from the live list but Matter 24 still held "Nordics". Show archived revealed it and Restore returned it live (archivedAt=null).

steps.action: Narrowing a Global Field is refused while another module attaches it
steps.actual: While Contract type "NDA" also attached the Global Field, narrowing to matter answered 404: {"type":"about:blank","title":"Not found","status":404,"detail":"Route PATCH /api/v1/fields/01a07f76-9db1-7251-888b-1b82b16bb3e2/scope does not exist.","instance":"/api/v1/fields/01a07f76-9db1-7251-88. After detaching that attachment the same narrow answered 404; the Field was returned to Global.
steps.error: Reviewer helper error, not product behaviour: the check called PATCH /fields/{id}/scope, but the route is PUT. Both calls answered 404 "Route ... does not exist", so this step proved nothing about the narrowing guard. Relabelled from pass to fail and redone through the Edit dialog in ind-requiredness-retry5.
